treatment: Actual default-review producer artifacts from controlled complete caller snapshots, consumed by the real review-verdict CLI. Fixed original kernel and review reference, unchanged operator guidance and accepted catalogue description in both arms. No caller acquisition or irreversible action is exercised. Literal-command runner. V2 broadens only the missing-coverage action recogniser to accept explicit assertions or AC2 coverage wording; V1 rejected a valid output and remains separate. Fresh Astra-low V3 comparison after Claude allowance exhaustion, with a separate strict title-to-heading artifact review.
acceptance: Five baseline and five candidate samples; require seven artifacts, seven actual contract consumptions and twenty separate decisions per sample, strict complete native audits and manual reading of all artifacts. Preserve failures. Human-judgement pass stays verbatim; do not pool providers. Candidate titles must match prose headings after stripping inline code and collapsing whitespace. Baseline title discrepancies are measured and reported separately; no candidate discrepancy is allowed. No Claude samples are pooled.
